description: Wire response for every MCP control-plane tool (ADR 0034). The host performs no acceptance itself — acceptance exists only behind the canonical review morphisms and operation gates this surface does not drive — so `result`'s top level pins the seven keys that could otherwise claim it: whenever one of them is present, it is constrained to the only value a host result can truthfully carry. This is the envelope's altitude only. A nested `accepted` (or any of the other six keys) at depth one or below inside `result` is payload semantics, not an envelope-level assertion: reads truthfully echo accepted ledger state — the `reviews` resource returns reviewed cells, memory projections carry claim statuses — and a recursive pin would make those reads schema-invalid. A consumer that needs a nested claim governed validates the payload against that payload's own contract. `result` and `refusal` are mutually exclusive and jointly exhaustive: exactly one is non-null.
